All 3 call sites to `InventoryService::save` are now covered — confirmed via `ast-tool callers` across the whole workspace, so no site was missed.

- `src/main.cpp:11-13` — added log before both `inv.save(p1)` and `inv.save(p2)`, plus `#include <iostream>` (wasn't previously included).
- `src/service/order_service.cpp:11` — added log before `inventory_.save(product)` inside `OrderService::save` (this file already had `<iostream>`).

Note: `orders.save(p1)` in `main.cpp` calls `OrderService::save`, not `InventoryService::save`, so it's correctly left untouched — its own internal call is what got the log line.
